summary: Two US federal systems reported break-ins this week: the USDA farm payment system and, per news reports, the FBI crime database. No official source links them or names who did it. Bitcoin bounced back above 60,000 dollars. I found no trading halts, big cloud outages or flight system failures.

events.title: FBI probes suspected breach of its national crime database
events.impact: Police use NCIC to check warrants and records. Nobody has said whether it was down or whether data was taken or changed. New: President Trump called the report 'not good' on Saturday.
events.stated_cause: Unknown. The FBI had not commented publicly as of Saturday. CNN and NBC cite two unnamed people briefed on the case. BleepingComputer sees no sign of a link to the September FBI jobs portal breach.

events.title: USDA cyber incident disrupts farm payment and loan systems
events.impact: Farm loan, payment and conservation tools were offline for days. A USDA official expected most systems back Friday, with work continuing over the weekend. He said no personal data was lost.
events.stated_cause: A USDA under secretary called it a cyberthreat. Staff reset database passwords. As of Friday night USDA had not named an attacker or given a detailed public account.

events.title: Iran and US trade strikes near Hormuz; drone claims
events.impact: New Saturday: Iran says it shot down two US drones over the Strait of Hormuz. The US had no immediate comment. Tankers face mine and attack risk. Reports say new US strikes are being weighed.
events.stated_cause: Iran says it is answering US actions. The US calls its strikes defensive. Talks to reopen the Strait are stalled. The US added new sanctions on four Iranians.

events.title: Bitcoin rebounds to about 60K USD after a drop below 57K
events.impact: Prices checked Saturday: CoinGecko 60,498 (24h range 55,298 to 62,087), Bitcoin.com 60,064 at 18:59 UTC, Bitget 60,181. Down about 8 to 12% on the week. One price page showed 55.8K but looked out of date. No exchange outage found.
events.stated_cause: No technical or attack cause reported. Moves track the wider stock selloff and heavy forced selling in crypto futures, per CoinDesk via Eurasia Business News.

events.title: US stocks fall sharply; Dow and S&P 500 in correction
events.impact: Friday close from last run: Nasdaq 22,617.73 (-5.28%), S&P 500 6,910.39 (-3.7%), Dow 48,147.33 (-1.93%). US markets are closed Saturday, so I could not recheck. I found no reports of trading halts.
events.stated_cause: Reports cite worry about AI spending, with Nvidia down 14%. No technical fault or cyber attack is reported.

events.title: CISA adds four actively exploited flaws to its catalog
events.impact: Covers SAP NetWeaver, Cisco Expressway, VMware vCenter and Apache Roller. Federal agencies must fix them. This is a routine notice, not an emergency directive.
events.stated_cause: CISA says it has evidence of active exploitation. It names no attacker.

events.title: Xsolla game payment service reports a major outage
events.impact: A forum post says Xsolla's status page shows a major outage in its Pay Station. Steam also saw a spike in checkout complaints earlier Saturday, but nobody has linked the two.
events.stated_cause: Unknown. Neither Xsolla nor Valve has given a cause in the items I saw.

events.title: Undersea cable fault slows internet in Pakistan
events.impact: Pakistan's telecom authority reported a SEA-ME-WE 5 fault offshore with slow service. I found no new update in this run.
events.stated_cause: Unknown and under investigation. Sabotage claims on social media are unverified.

events.title: Cloudflare status page shows degraded performance
events.impact: Cloudflare's status feed lists Sites and Services as degraded, last changed 07:44 UTC Nov 21. I saw no wire report of a wide outage.
events.stated_cause: Unknown. Cloudflare gave no cause in the data I saw.

connection_assessment.reasoning: The USDA says it was hit by a cyberthreat and nobody has named who did it. The FBI crime database breach has no stated cause or attacker. No official source links the two, and reporters have found no link to last week's outages, which officials gave ordinary causes for. Airline, bank and market feeds look normal.
connection_assessment.would_change_my_mind: An official statement blaming the same attacker or company for the USDA and FBI breaches, or several big systems failing at the same moment.

alert.reason: Two separate government breaches are being investigated, but no link, no attacker and no wider system failure has been reported.

prep_note: Farmers using USDA loan or payment tools may see delays this weekend. Check with your local FSA office before deadlines. Everyone else: no action needed. Keep your usual backups and passwords up to date, and watch official FBI and USDA updates.
